scope_change_reason: Handoff-first side result in the unchanged alphabet, not an added operation or physical supplier. The predecessor leaves the Q=10 and Q=11 readout minima open; a sharp pair-sum theorem closes those cases and identifies the first Q attaining the absolute readout floor.
bottleneck_link: Side result: settles sharpness of the abstract readout relaxation; the predecessor already excludes tariff gains for this family. No supplier, selected assumption or kappa improvement follows.
stop_rule: Stop after elementary pair-sum proofs, complete query-count frontier, independent bounded checks and publication. Do not expand to physical realization or another source-count census.
evidence: Elementary affine-relation-code proofs establish the complete readout frontier. Independent normalized point and kernel-code censuses corroborate the sharp bounds; literal even-parity witnesses, padding checks and seven failure controls pass in normal and optimized Python.
